input.summary: Shorten non-renewal notice to 30 days, set renewal terms at 12 months, add renewal reminder and cap on renewal price increases
input.comment: [Playbook] We have shortened the non-renewal notice window to 30 days, aligned the Attachment renewal period with the 12-month Base term, and added a renewal reminder and a cap on renewal price increases (lesser of CPI and 3%). Six- and twelve-month exit notice periods sit beyond our walk-away threshold of 90 days; if helpful we can live with a 60-day notice window and a 5% uplift cap as a fallback.

ops.oldText: This Agreement will automatically be renewed for periods of twelve (12) months unless either Party gives six (6) months written notice of its intent to terminate this Agreement.
ops.newText: This Agreement will automatically be renewed for periods of twelve (12) months unless either Party gives thirty (30) days written notice, prior to the end of the then-current period, of its intent to terminate this Agreement. MSL will notify IBM of each upcoming renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current period, and any price increase applicable to a renewal period shall not exceed the lesser of the increase in the Consumer Price Index over the preceding twelve (12) months or three percent (3%).

ops.oldText: This Attachment will automatically be renewed for periods of six (6) months unless either party gives twelve (12) months written notice of its intent to terminate this Agreement.
